# rm
---
`rm` stands for remove. It delets files at path. You cannot delete directorys with rm, but you can if you use the -rf flag. _be **VERY CAREFUL** with rm -rf_. There is no "Are you sure?", it just deletes.
## Assignment:
Steve asked us to get rid of his data and the stupid law says we have to, so delete the steve_report.txt file. DO NOT DELETE THE FULL DIRECTORY. Submit in the root of the starter assets.
